config.unjudged_books: count as not relevant; condensed_ndcg_at_10 removes them before scoring
config.confidence_interval: percentile bootstrap over queries, 10000 resamples, confidence 0.95, seed 0
config.significance: two-sided paired permutation test (sign flips) on per-query ndcg_at_10, 10000 resamples, seed 0; Holm correction across all systems compared with the baseline

systems.vector_only: FAISS only (dense embeddings, index in data/indexes/faiss_index)
systems.hybrid_rrf: BM25 + FAISS fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (SearchService)
systems.hybrid_rrf_mmr: hybrid_rrf re-ranked with MMR (lambda 0.6 over the top 20)
